verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs describe several features that turn the user's email data into AI insights and suggestions inside the product. Instant Summaries appear at the top of every thread, Ghostwriter offers autocomplete based on the user's previous emails, and the AI assistant searches the full email history and helps identify important emails and todos. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of how good these insights are (community evidence only incidentally mentions the AI summaries).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Instant Summaries show up at the very top of your email threads the instant you open them.
These AI suggestions are intelligent and based on previous emails you've written, so they sound just like you
it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more
Identify important emails & todos with a single click.
Read, summarize, and analyze PDF, text, code, and other file types with the AI Assistant
